Name: Kenneth's Green Cabbage and Star Candy
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Green Cabbage and Star Candy - Content Patcher[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This mod adds 2 new crops.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Green Cabbage Leaf grows in spring and summer. It is a simple vegetable for everyday cooking.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Star Candy Piece grows in fall and winter. It is a sweet candy crop for desserts.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]It also adds 2 new cooking recipes.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Sauteed Cabbage and Star Pie.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Seeds are sold at Kenneth's Seed Shop.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Cooked dishes are sold at Kenneth's Restaurant.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]All recipes can also be cooked at home.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This mod is balanced for vanilla gameplay and designed to fit naturally into the game.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Credits:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Original mod and sprites by MarcyTheBeast.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Content Patcher version by Kf, used with permission.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Original Mod: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9227, https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11941[/b][/size]
